about.description: Remora Markets is a blockchain-based platform providing infrastructure for tokenization and on-chain financial services. It enables users to access and trade diverse digital assets through decentralized protocols.
about.registryInfo: Remora Markets is a tokenized real-estate platform - issues tokens representing fractional ownership of single-property real-estate assets. US-based, focused on residential single-family-rental investments.

fees.revenueNotes: Remora earns property-management fees (typically 8-10% of rental income), acquisition fees on new properties, and asset-management fees. Revenue does not accrue to a protocol token (Remora is a Reg-D / Reg-A issuer rather than a token economy).
